authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 941 aṣṭā/aṣṭau explicitly gives B. āṭ, Kalasha aṣṭ and Khowar oṣṭ eight. These dental/retroflex, rounded and nasalized variants identify that numeral family. Discovery comparator: Dm aṣṭ “eight” (f_x4kwo36wra44y). The full primary entry was reviewed independently of the existing match. Exact survey forms are preserved.
